info.name: BILLING REST API — Offline Acceptance Collection
info.description: Offline Postman collection mapped to the supplied 14 epics / 86 stories and current Spring controller routes + ApiDtos. No database or live endpoint was accessed. See postman/README.md. Write guard defaults OFF and skips every non-GET request until allowWrites=true is deliberately set.

exec: // Default-deny non-read requests. Enable only against an isolated test system.
const method = pm.request.method.toUpperCase();
const allowWrites = String(pm.environment.get("allowWrites") || pm.collectionVariables.get("allowWrites") || "false").toLowerCase() === "true";
if (!["GET", "HEAD", "OPTIONS"].includes(method) && !allowWrites) {
console.warn("Skipped non-read request: set allowWrites=true only for an isolated test system.");
pm.execution.skipRequest();
const suffix = Date.now().toString(36) + Math.random().toString(36).slice(2, 7);
pm.collectionVariables.set("runSuffix", suffix);
pm.environment.set("runSuffix", suffix);
pm.environment.set("testUsername", "pm_" + suffix);
pm.environment.set("testEmail", "pm_" + suffix + "@example.invalid");
pm.environment.set("testSku", "PM-" + suffix.toUpperCase().slice(-16));
pm.environment.set("testPhone", "555" + String(Math.floor(1000000 + Math.random() * 9000000)));
pm.environment.set("supplierEmail", "supplier_" + suffix + "@example.invalid");
pm.environment.set("unknownUsername", "missing_" + suffix);
const csrf = pm.environment.get("csrfToken") || pm.collectionVariables.get("csrfToken");
if (csrf && !["GET", "HEAD", "OPTIONS"].includes(method)) pm.request.headers.upsert({key:"X-XSRF-TOKEN", value:csrf});
